metadata.geoclick:note: Shared style for all admin-1 demo maps. The 'targets' source url is a placeholder (pmtiles://./tiles.pmtiles) — the map viewer composes the final style per map by replacing it with that map's own tiles.pmtiles URL. Each tileset has two source-layers (see data/scripts/build-map.ts): 'targets' (polygons, for fill/outline/hit-testing) and 'labels' (one point per feature at its precomputed centroid, so text labels don't duplicate at tile boundaries the way polygon-derived label placement does).
